parsed.title: AOL Ad-Free Sprint
parsed.oneLiner: Enjoy 15 minutes of ad-free news browsing after a quick game.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)
AD TODAY banner on Article Ad View (e17)

newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed entitlement that suppresses all native and banner advertisements across news feeds and article pages, including Taboola native units (e47, e48) and banners (e22).
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app relies on high-density native ad placements which interrupt the core reading loop; this adds a scarcity-based value exchange to drive engagement.

parsed.trigger: User browses the Home News Feed where Taboola ad density (e47) is prominent.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users currently exposed to standard ad density.

offer.title: Go Ad-Free for 15 Minutes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to clear all ads (including Taboola units) for a short sprint.

reward.what: 15 minutes of ad-free news browsing (hides Taboola ads)

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 15 minutes, serving as a premium sampling effect. It is capped at 3 uses per day to ensure it remains a supplement to, rather than a replacement for, standard reading.
risks: Users may grow accustomed to ad-free reading and find the return to standard density jarring.
Potential revenue dip if sprint sessions overlap with peak reading times.

newElements.change: A button with a lightning icon titled 'Ad-Free Sprint' placed in the feed header for high visibility.
A small countdown timer badge next to the 'Home' title indicating remaining ad-free time when active.

callouts.text: User browses news with frequent native ad units.

storyboard.caption: The user reads their news feed and encounters a native Taboola advertising unit.
A new 'Ad-Free Sprint' button is added to the feed header, offering an ad-free experience.
The user taps the button; Simula MiniGameInvitation appears, disclosing the 15-second requirement.
The user plays a quick 15-second game with the AOL News Editor.
The sprint begins; Taboola ad units are hidden and a timer tracks the remaining time.
